response.overview: It’s 1996. Former assassin Noelle Duff-Brompton is living in New York City under the name Allie Shepherd after the Cold War, trying to live a normal life. She has a normal job, a cozy apartment, and a caring fiancé. One day, she lingers in the church after Sunday Mass and goes to the confession booth. She tells the pastor on the other side the complete story of her life, as he listens silently. We watch her life unfold in detail. The pastor is her fiancé, and she knows it. But does he know that it’s her?
response.tagline: Forgive me Father, for I have sinned.
response.title: The Confession
